We qualify Basics unit 3's output contract before relying on the proposed explanations. Eleven finite host models and fifteen fresh Spectrum ROM PRINT contrasts check text versus arithmetic, explicit spaces, immediate joining, comma zones and continuation. The actual wrong-separator variant exits nonzero. Two failed harness attempts remain labelled separately from the successful run.

The evidence pack includes complete screen rows, tool/source/build identities, readable wide/narrow browser captures, independent learner tasks and assessor notes. Its validator checks source hashes, model/native correspondence, browser results and local links, and rejects deliberately corrupt evidence. The complete per-unit map keeps its immutable baseline.

Validation: final production build, 237 repository tests, six browser behaviour groups, scoped closed/revealed axe scans, Ruff, Vale, evidence validation and all 24 manifest entries pass. No learner is available: effectiveness, retention and unaided transfer remain unknown. #114/#115/#124 stay open.

Companion website PR: https://github.com/code198x/website/pull/759

Next bounded candidate: an independent interpreter-trace prediction in From Source to Silicon unit 2, starting from the existing translation pilot and current source.
title: Qualify output joining and prepare independent learner tasks
